args.body: After TENDER-OFFER-CANDIDATE-REVIEW records an independent APPROVE, advance the unchanged offer in a later eligible publishing turn through the host gate. Check equivalent release evidence first. Reproduce exact approved digest, deploy once, FETCH the homepage and compare its hash with approved index b962f53d7a9561d9e0fa003fad0f2cd7613bba0f981b6fa3f950e4ab75186707; save/read publication evidence. Stop on rejection or mismatch without repeated probes. If NEEDS_WORK, route concrete findings to BUILDER instead of publishing. Release establishes availability only; commercial evidence requires an actual classified eligible request or price question, with attribution uncertainty disclosed. No outreach, spending or new inventory. Preserve existing observation windows, December 4 welfare retirement, December 7 North Ayrshire expiry including the offer section, and January 8 tender-page retirement.

description: The prepared CAD49 source-reconciliation offer now has executed feasibility checks and an exact candidate digest. Advance it to independent review before release.
